scientific_integrity: Source equations and prior qualitative polarization are credited. Executable numerical checks are separated from the analytic proof. Novelty remains a best-knowledge assessment and independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite undirected connected simple graphs, real beta sufficiently large for the existence part, fixed \(K>1\) and \(\delta>0\); no global attraction or stochastic claims; zero-coordinate equilibria not classified. The all-parameter sign obstruction and \(K\leq1\) result are exact.
title: A graph-matching criterion for stable polarization under strong homophily
